selection_stage: secondary (log-loss tie within epsilon, resolved by highest mean ROC-AUC)
selection_rule: 1) PRIMARY: lowest mean outer-fold log loss. 2) EQUIVALENCE: within 0.002 of the best mean log loss counts as tied. 3) highest mean ROC-AUC. 4) lowest mean Brier. 5) highest mean accuracy. 6) lower log-loss standard deviation. 7) COMPLEXITY (deterministic): lower max_depth -> higher min_child_weight -> higher gamma -> higher reg_lambda -> higher reg_alpha -> lower median effective tree count -> candidate_id. subsample/colsample_bytree are tunable predictive hyperparameters and are deliberately NOT used as a complexity ranking. Fit time never participates in selection.
